title: Corrected field paths for Apple Messages for Business interactive replies
summary: The Apple Messages for Business API reference now points to interactive_reply for quick reply, list picker and time picker responses.
body_markdown:
The API reference for[send message](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/create-amb-message) ,[get message](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/get-amb-message) ,[list messages](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/list-amb-messages) ,[list conversation messages](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/list-amb-conversation-messages) , and[get template version language](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/get-amb-template-version-language) previously described a customer's quick reply, list picker, or time picker selection as arriving on` interactive_data.data.*` . That field no longer exists; selections arrive on` interactive_reply` .


The docs now point to the right paths:


- A quick reply selection is` interactive_reply.quick_reply.selected_identifier` .
- A list picker selection is` interactive_reply.list_picker.sections\[\].items\[\]` .
- A time picker selection is` interactive_reply.reply_message.title` or a slot identifier under` interactive_reply` .
- An image identifier referenced from a row or button resolves against` interactive.images` on the outbound message, or` interactive_reply.images` on a reply.


If you were parsing replies against the old` interactive_data.data` path, switch to` interactive_reply` .
